title: PEACEMAKER OR TROUBLEMAKER: HOW SYCOPHANCY SHAPES MULTI-AGENT DEBATE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-agent debate interactions on reasoning datasets (MMLU Pro and CommonsenseQA) using custom metrics like Disagreement Collapse Rate (DCR) and Sycophancy Score (SS) to quantify how often agents abandon correct answers to superficially agree with peers, alongside testing model performance under controlled sycophancy levels using persona-based system prompts.
